senses.definition: A multicoloured arch in the sky, produced by prismatic refraction of light within droplets of rain in the air.

quotes.text:
Why are there so many songs about rainbows
And what's on the other side?
Rainbows are visions, but only illusions
And rainbows have nothing to hide.

senses.definition: Any prismatic refraction of light showing a spectrum of colours.
(often used with “of”) A wide assortment; a varied multitude.

examples: Many electoral promises are rainbows, vanishing soon after poll day.

senses.definition: (baseball) A curveball, particularly a slow one.
(soccer) A trick in which the player makes the ball arc over the opponent's head using both feet; rainbow kick
(poker slang) In Texas hold 'em or Omaha hold 'em, a flop that contains three different suits.

senses.definition: Multicolored, especially if in rainbow order.
